description: 48-task expanded end-to-end agent benchmark for retrieval grounding, multi-turn context, personalization, misconception repair, code-boundary explanations, and safety edges.

generation.note: The Mimo draft was used as topical seed material; final tasks were manually normalized to the executable AgentTask schema and audited before inclusion.

rules: Each task must be loadable by benchmarks.agent_benchmark.AgentTask.from_dict.
Tool expectations must align with current course-agent boundaries: course knowledge uses retrieval; safety/off-topic edges do not.
Personalized tasks must include StudentProfile-compatible seed_profile fields.
Keyword groups must be broad enough for answer variation but specific enough to score required dimensions.

tasks.description: 教材知识问答：数据科学定义与跨学科特征

tasks.notes: 基础概念，检查 RAG 能否引用教材定义。
